STS2BALANCEMOD-SUNDIAL.title: Sundial
STS2BALANCEMOD-SUNDIAL.description: Every [blue]{Shuffles}[/blue] times you shuffle your [blue]Draw Pile[/blue], gain [blue]{Energy}[/blue].
STS2BALANCEMOD-SUNDIAL.flavor: "Early man's foolish obsession with time caused them to look to the sky for guidance, hoping for something permanent." - Zoroth
STS2BALANCEMOD-ORANGE_PILL.title: Orange Pill
STS2BALANCEMOD-ORANGE_PILL.description: Each turn, after you play a [gold]Power[/gold], an [gold]Attack[/gold], and a [gold]Skill[/gold], remove all negative effects from yourself.
STS2BALANCEMOD-ORANGE_PILL.flavor: "A pill made from all the fungi in the Spire. Cures everything!"
STS2BALANCEMOD-DEAD_BRANCH.title: Dead Branch
STS2BALANCEMOD-DEAD_BRANCH.description: Whenever you [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card, add a random card into your hand.
STS2BALANCEMOD-DEAD_BRANCH.flavor: The branch of a tree from a forgotten era.
STS2BALANCEMOD-OMAMORI.title: Omamori
STS2BALANCEMOD-OMAMORI.description: Negate the next 2 [purple]Curses[/purple] you would obtain.
STS2BALANCEMOD-OMAMORI.flavor: A common charm for staving off vile spirits. This one seems to possess a spark of the divine.
